title: Human-decision judge verdict file (human_decision_batch_<n>.json)
description: The file a human-decision judging subagent's reply is persisted to at output_path. The wrapper object (rather than a bare array) is what lets the ingest distinguish a truncated write from a legitimately empty verdict set. `decision` is a wire vocabulary: the ingest translates approve -> approved, skip -> skipped, salvage -> approved plus the judge_auto_decide_salvage markers.

judge.description: Optional: the model the judging agent says it is. Names a native (host-agent) judge in the report; an executor-run judge is named by its runner instead.

group_id.description: The stable group id (= group_hash) the verdict belongs to. Verdicts are mapped by this id, never by batch or list position.

salvaged_description.description: The rewritten description that gets applied. Non-null iff decision == salvage.

dropped.description: What was intentionally left out. Non-null iff decision == salvage.
